name: Spicy Spycy!
source:
"Come on, don't care about our mission! We should pick up girls?!" Souma, a member of a secret agency, is sent to a school on mission. He first thinks it is a boring job, but there are actually a lot of pretty girls! "What? Draw information from them? Great! Wrest it by giving them erotic things..." Yes, he plans to give the girls who seem to have a secret erotic tortures. His mission is to find an item called "Supreme Key". Well, will he successfully get it?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
“得了吧，别管我们的任务了！我们去泡妞？！”相马是一名秘密机构成员，被派往一所学校执行任务。他一开始觉得这是一份无聊的工作，但其实有很多漂亮的女孩！“什么？从她们那里获取情报？太好了！给她们色情的东西来夺取它……” 是的，他打算给那些似乎有秘密色情的女孩带来折磨。他的任务是寻找一种名为“至尊钥匙”的物品。那么，他能顺利拿到吗？
